project.name: Servo Motor Conjugate Heat Transfer - Air-Cooled Finned Housing

mesh.mesher: Simmetrix tetrahedral, manual sizing 20 mm / 0.8 mm

fluid_properties.name: Air (SimScale incompressible preset)
fluid_properties.note: k is not stored for an incompressible fluid; it follows from mu*cp/Pr = 0.025770 W/mK. mu = nu*rho.

result_controls.note: Area averages on the inlet and outlet faces, read from the results API at the final iteration.

solid_fields.note: Cell-centre temperature statistics of the converged solid fields, recovered from the result archive (1000/regionN/T.gz). The solids carry only T. region2 has 66 boundary patches and region3 has 3, which matches the housing and winding CAD face counts exactly.

convergence.note: see results/convergence.json for the downsampled histories

provenance: Fluid monitors: area-average result controls on the inlet and outlet faces, read from the SimScale results API at the final iteration of Run 2 (result 8ce326bb-b300-4314-a843-1ea0caf79e92). Solid temperatures: the result archive (result.zip, OpenFOAM ASCII fields per region) was streamed and the entries 1000/region2/T.gz and 1000/region3/T.gz decompressed and parsed; statistics are over cell-centre values. The two solid surface-data result controls produced no plots in this solver version, so no surface-averaged solid values exist.
